blocks.text: Why Work in Manitoba With Goodwill Staffing?

blocks.html: Paid travel and furnished housing. Flexible short- and long-term contracts. Full licensing guidance and support for CRNM and CLPNM. Work in bilingual, remote, and culturally diverse environments. Weekly pay and 24/7 recruiter support. Contracts from 2 weeks to 6+ months.
Getting Started with Goodwill Staffing is as Easy as 1, 2, 3!
Fill out our quick online application and connect with a friendly Career Consultant to explore your ideal travel assignment.
Our Credentialing Team helps you gather and verify all your licenses and paperwork quickly and stress-free.
Our Travel Team will coordinate all your travel and accommodations—just pack your bags and we’ll handle the rest.
You focus on making an impact—we’ll take care of timesheets, reimbursements, and continuous support throughout your assignment.

items.question: Where are the most common placements?
items.answer: Winnipeg, Brandon, Northern Manitoba, and fly-in Indigenous communities.

items.question: What’s the typical contract length?
items.answer: Most contracts are 4 to 12 weeks, with options to extend.

items.question: Do I need remote or rural experience?
items.answer: Not required, but it’s an asset. We provide relocation assistance.

items.question: Can I apply if I’m from another province?
What kind of housing is provided?
items.answer: Most placements include fully furnished housing near your assignment.

items.question: Can I apply if I’m newly licensed?
items.answer: Candidates must have at least 2 years of relevant experience to qualify for placements.

blocks.html: We help you navigate the provincial licensing process and reimburse licensing fees under select terms and conditions—so you can focus on getting started stress-free.
Travel RNs and LPNs in Manitoba must hold an active nursing license and valid BLS certification. Ensure your documents are current and ready to upload.
All RNs must be licensed through the College of Registered Nurses of Manitoba (CRNM), and LPNs through the College of Licensed Practical Nurses of Manitoba (CLPNM).
You may also need to submit a vulnerable sector check, immunization records, and proof of insurance. Our team will guide you through every step.
Have questions about Manitoba nursing requirements? Our team can point you in the right direction and make sure you’re prepared for every step of the process.
Goodwill Staffing places RNs, LPNs, PSWs, and HCAs across Manitoba with housing, licensing support, and flexible contracts. From Winnipeg to the North, we’re here to support your healthcare career.
